business.name: Tarn Lake Cottage
business.tagline: A quiet two-bedroom cottage on the water, ten minutes from town.

services.name: Two bedrooms
services.description: A queen room and a twin room, both with lake views.

services.name: Private deck
services.description: Morning sun, a barbecue and the lake at the bottom of the garden.

services.name: Kayaks and bikes
services.description: Free to use during your stay.

about.story: We are Anna and James, and we live ten minutes up the road. We built the cottage for our own family holidays, and now we share it with guests. We meet you on arrival if you like, and we are always a phone call away.

reviews.quote: Waking up to the lake every morning was magic. The cottage had everything we needed and Anna's tips for walks were spot on.
reviews.author: Sophie L.

reviews.quote: Booked direct, saved on fees and got a warm welcome. We are already planning to come back next summer.
reviews.author: The Ngata family

hero.alt: Lake with autumn trees reflected in still water
